name: @pired/lightroom-mcp
description: MCP server for Adobe Lightroom Classic: catalog search, presets, export, hybrid AI denoise, spot removal, local + AI + range masks, tone curves, Auto tone/WB, resets, process version, snapshots, selection & navigation, IPTC batch metadata, flags, color labels, virtual copies, smart collections, JPEG previews with inline images and watermarks.
long_description: Connects any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or the bundled DeepSeek harness) to a running Adobe Lightroom Classic instance via a bundled Lua plugin. All 18 tools of the original lightroom-mcp (catalog search, collections, ratings, keywords, develop presets and settings, import and export) plus 38 additions: hybrid ai_denoise (native Adobe AI Denoise via keyboard automation with smart manual fallback), set_noise_reduction, set_white_balance, set_flags, get/add/clear_spots, add_local_adjustment (linear/radial masks), read_local_adjustments, list_watermarks, AI masks (subject/sky/background/objects/people/landscape) with adjustment presets, range masks (luminance/color/depth), mask inventory management, tone curves, official Auto tone/WB, develop settings read, scoped resets, process version switching, develop snapshots, UI selection & filmstrip navigation, photo status (flag/rating/label), batch IPTC metadata, rotation, catalog removal (confirm-gated), folders, keywords, view filter, collection photos and sets, and JPEG previews attached as inline images (the 'preview gate' workflow). Server-side tool filtering via LIGHTROOM_MCP_TOOLS. The Lightroom plugin is auto-installed into Lightroom's Modules folder on first run; restart Lightroom once after install to load it.

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search the catalog by filename, keywords, rating, or date.

tools.name: get_selected_photos
tools.description: Photos currently selected in Lightroom (or the filmstrip).

tools.name: get_photo_metadata
tools.description: Detailed EXIF + develop metadata for a photo.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all collections and collection sets.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection.

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Add photos to an existing collection.

tools.name: set_keywords
tools.description: Add or remove keywords on photos.

tools.name: set_rating
tools.description: Set star rating on photos.

tools.name: import_photos
tools.description: Import photos into the catalog.

tools.name: export_photos
tools.description: Export photos with format/quality/dimensions.

tools.name: list_develop_presets
tools.description: List available Develop presets.

tools.name: get_develop_preset
tools.description: Read the settings of one exact Develop preset.

tools.name: compare_develop_presets
tools.description: Diff two Develop presets per setting.

tools.name: create_develop_preset
tools.description: Create a versioned plugin-managed preset checkpoint from a photo.

tools.name: export_develop_preset
tools.description: Copy a custom/checkpoint preset backing file to a destination.

tools.name: apply_develop_preset
tools.description: Apply a Develop preset to photos.

tools.name: copy_develop_settings
tools.description: Copy Develop settings from one photo to others.

tools.name: set_develop_settings
tools.description: Set Develop settings directly on a photo.

tools.name: ai_denoise
tools.description: Hybrid AI noise reduction: triggers Adobe's native AI Denoise (Photo > Enhance) via keyboard automation and verifies the new DNG; falls back to ISO-aware manual sliders.

tools.name: set_noise_reduction
tools.description: Set manual noise reduction and sharpening sliders.

tools.name: set_white_balance
tools.description: White balance via preset (As Shot/Auto/...) or Kelvin temperature + tint.

tools.name: set_flags
tools.description: Set pick/reject flags on photos.

tools.name: get_spots
tools.description: List the spot removal (heal/clone) spots of a photo.

tools.name: add_spots
tools.description: Add heal/clone spots at normalized coordinates.

tools.name: clear_spots
tools.description: Remove all spot removal spots.

tools.name: add_local_adjustment
tools.description: Add a linear or radial local adjustment mask with exposure/color sliders.

tools.name: read_local_adjustments
tools.description: Inspect the local masks a photo has, including AI masks.

tools.name: list_watermarks
tools.description: List watermark presets usable with export_photos.

tools.name: add_ai_mask
tools.description: Create an AI selection mask (Select Subject/Sky/Background/Objects/People/Landscape) with optional adjustment sliders applied to the new mask (Lightroom Classic 12.4+).

tools.name: list_masks
tools.description: List the masks of a photo through the Develop module (count plus each entry verbatim).

tools.name: remove_mask
tools.description: Remove one mask from a photo by id, verified through the before/after mask count.

tools.name: set_tone_curve
tools.description: Set a point curve (main luminance or RGB channel) from [x, y] points in 0-255 space, or a built-in preset; endpoints are added automatically.

tools.name: get_tone_curve
tools.description: Read a photo's tone curves: curve name plus main/red/green/blue point curves.

tools.name: apply_auto
tools.description: Apply Lightroom's official Auto Tone and/or Auto White Balance commands, with a before/after slider diff per photo.

tools.name: set_color_label
tools.description: Set the color label on photos (red/yellow/green/blue/purple/none), verified per photo.

tools.name: create_virtual_copies
tools.description: Create virtual copies of photos (same file, independent develop settings).

tools.name: create_smart_collection
tools.description: Create a smart collection from rules (keywords, rating, dates, camera...), combined with AND or OR.

tools.name: get_photo_preview
tools.description: Render a JPEG preview of a photo and attach it inline (the 'preview gate' workflow).

tools.name: get_develop_settings
tools.description: Read a photo's develop settings (basic sliders or the full set).

tools.name: reset_develop
tools.description: Reset all adjustments, specific tools, or specific parameters.

tools.name: set_process_version
tools.description: Switch the process version (modernize old photos to unlock AI masking).

tools.name: create_snapshot
tools.description: Create a named develop snapshot (undo checkpoint).

tools.name: select_photos
tools.description: Set the Lightroom UI selection by ids or mode (all/none/inverse).

tools.name: navigate_photo
tools.description: Move to the next/previous photo in the filmstrip.

tools.name: get_photo_status
tools.description: Read flag, rating and color label per photo.

tools.name: batch_metadata
tools.description: Set IPTC text fields (title, caption, location, creator...) on many photos.

tools.name: rotate_photo
tools.description: Rotate photos 90 degrees left or right (batch).

tools.name: remove_from_catalog
tools.description: Remove photos from the catalog (files are kept); requires confirm=true.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List the catalog's folder tree with photo counts.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: List top-level keywords with photo counts.

tools.name: manage_view_filter
tools.description: Read, set or clear the Library view filter.

tools.name: get_collection_photos
tools.description: List the photos of a collection (paginated).

tools.name: create_collection_set
tools.description: Create a collection set (optionally nested in a parent set).

tools.name: add_range_mask
tools.description: Create luminance/color/depth range masks with adjustments.

tools.name: toggle_mask_overlay
tools.description: Toggle the red mask overlay in the Develop view.

tools.name: set_mask_adjustments
tools.description: Apply local sliders to a mask the photo already has.

request_port.title: Plugin request port
request_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin listens on for requests. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.

response_port.title: Plugin response port
response_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin sends responses on. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.
